requirements.title: Log a job
requirements.statement: The front desk logs a job with boat name, owner name and phone, engine make and model, the owner's complaint and the date the boat comes in; the job number is given automatically.

requirements.title: Assign a technician
requirements.statement: The Workshop Manager assigns each job to one technician.

requirements.title: Job statuses
requirements.statement: A job moves Booked → In workshop → Waiting for parts → Done → Invoiced, each step by the role that owns it; the front desk can cancel a job before In workshop.

requirements.title: Hours and parts on the job
requirements.statement: The technician records hours worked and parts used on the job from a phone, replacing the paper job card.

requirements.title: Waiting-for-parts list
requirements.statement: A list of every boat waiting for parts, oldest first, for the Workshop Manager and the front desk.

requirements.title: Job-done WhatsApp message
requirements.statement: When a job is Done the boat owner gets a WhatsApp message from the workshop's WhatsApp Business number saying the boat is ready for collection.

requirements.title: Monthly technician report
requirements.statement: A monthly report of jobs and hours per technician for the Owner and the Workshop Manager.

requirements.title: Daily list for invoicing
requirements.statement: Accounts gets a daily list of Done jobs to key invoices into Tally by hand, then marks each job Invoiced; invoices stay in Tally.

requirements.title: Customers and boats
requirements.statement: Boat owners and boat yards are kept as customers; one owner can have several boats, and each boat keeps its job history.

requirements.title: Record a parts order
requirements.statement: The Sales Lead records a parts order with customer, parts with quantity and price, discount and Tally number.

requirements.title: Parts order statuses
requirements.statement: A parts order moves Quoted → Confirmed → Delivered → Paid; the Sales Lead moves it to Delivered, Accounts sets Paid; it can be cancelled before Delivered.

requirements.title: Discount approval
requirements.statement: A discount above 10% needs the Owner's approval (the Workshop Manager when she is away) before the order goes on.

requirements.title: Unpaid orders list
requirements.statement: A list of parts orders Delivered and not Paid 30 days after delivery, for the Sales Lead and Accounts.

requirements.title: Orders from the phone
requirements.statement: The Sales Lead can create and update parts orders from her phone at the boat yards.

requirements.title: Tally stock in view
requirements.statement: The Sales Lead can see Tally stock for a part when quoting.

requirements.title: Who sees what
requirements.statement: Technicians see only their own jobs; the Owner sees everything.

requirements.title: Move the Excel job history
requirements.statement: All columns of the Jobs 2025 and Jobs 2026 Excel sheets (about 900 rows) move into the new system; parts order history stays in Tally.

requirements.title: English and AED
requirements.statement: English only; prices in AED.

requirements.title: Training
requirements.statement: Everyone who uses the system is trained; Neome trains the Workshop Manager and the Sales Lead, who train their teams.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.statement: Standard Neome support; the Owner raises issues.
